summary: The implementation matches the settled design on every point checked. Independent test run on the branch tree reproduced the claimed count exactly (1 failed, 10509 passed, 6 skipped, 3 xfailed), and the single failure is tests/test_github_oidc_trust_policy.py::test_fixer_covers_every_oidc_role_the_repository_declares, inherited from the merge-base 1102da71 via upstream commit 4ee4c498 and already resolved at the current origin/stack tip 0a59ecf8 by b350ceb7 deleting the workflow it objects to - it touches no path in this branch's diff and was correctly not repaired here. F-1: all five applied:0 arms carry a reason (unconfigured, read_failed, read_only_inspect, the derived disabled/dry_run, nothing_to_apply), the two-situation arm derives from `enabled` rather than hard-coding, MetaCatalogReadError carries status and errorKind structurally, graphStatus and graphErrorKind are read via getattr so a Wix failure reaching the same arm carries neither, and no Graph response body is logged anywhere. F-2: the resolve_payment_reference read is guarded, catches order_keys.OrderIdentityUnavailable specifically with no bare Exception in the block, native defaults to False so an unreadable row still sends the review, and test_an_error_outside_the_storage_wrapper_is_not_swallowed injects a KeyError at dynamodb.Table() - inside the guard's try, outside _read_row's. F-4: seven sites guarded, both inline regexes converted, the UUID literal held in exactly one file (customer_auth.py, pinned by a tree-walking test), each site's original refusal mechanism preserved (send-then-return, raise CustomerNotAuthorized, or return outcome), and both pin tests present including the site-count assertion of 7. F-5: six sites converted (five webhook, one invoice engine), invoice-engine's negation preserved as `if not order_keys.is_conditional_failure(claim_err)`, the eight out-of-scope substring sites byte-identical to origin/stack, OpaqueConditionalFailure test-local only. F-6: list_orders returns a plain list, an all-legacy input yields [] so NO_ORDERS fires, has_prior_order exists and catalog_services.py calls it, and order_choices_unnumbered carries `skipped` as its only payload field. F-9: copy corrected at both sites with 403 and GRANT_NOT_REDEEMABLE unchanged, and the re-issue route was not implemented (no reissue parameter, REISSUE_CAP or reissueCount under amplify, and tests/test_vault_download_reissue.py absent). F-10: VAULT_DELIVERY_DEFERRED returned when neither link nor document was delivered, reason enum bound as not_deliverable -> no_delivery_key -> window_closed with first match winning, review send still happens before the check, log line carries only requestId and reason. Boundaries held: no remote tracking branch so nothing pushed, no deploy, no published version, no alias move, no production invoke, every named flag read still defaulting to 'false' and byte-identical, no secret value read, no broad staging or history rewrite, no record deleted, no auth/ownership/isolation check weakened, and the one new try block narrows rather than widens its catch. Full analysis in 2026-10-09-165134-review.md alongside this file.
